reasoning_traces.think:
The core mathematical structure emerges from a probabilistic content evaluation pipeline where each Instagram post is treated as a sample from a heterogeneous mixture model. The classifier primitive assigns each post to one of four verdict classes, forming a multinomial distribution over V ∈ {TEST, LEARN-ONLY, CONTEXT-ONLY, WATCH}. This allows GSI to compute a posterior belief over utility using Bayesian inference with conjugate priors. The source locator primitive defines a composite kernel S_total = S_dm ∪ S_feed, which enables a joint likelihood model for content provenance. The novelty assessment primitive ensures that each post contributes uniquely to belief formation by enforcing disjointness with prior knowledge sets. Together, these primitives define a dynamic Bayesian network where nodes represent content items and edges encode conditional dependencies induced by source and verdict structures. Failure modes include overfitting to small samples, incorrect classification, and contamination from overlapping indices.
